summary: Iter 231j (Pending Trades Dashboard Banner + Trade Config Enforcement) tested end-to-end. All 9 backend pytests in test_iter231j_trade_config_and_banner.py pass. Regression checks on iter231g (trades config CRUD, 4/4) and iter231h (state machine, 8/8) all green. Frontend e2e via Playwright as chriszarek@gmail.com confirmed the banner renders both buckets correctly (1 awaiting_response + 20 in_review), trade row data-testids are present, deep-links to /transactions/trade/{tradeId} work, and the Trade Detail page renders the Pending Response banner with Accept/Reject buttons. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: PendingTradesBanner.jsx is clean and focused (~145 lines). Renders null when both buckets empty, paginates UI to top 3 with overflow caption.
Backend route /api/users/me/pending-trades correctly aggregates across leagues and segments by user role (recipient on 'proposed' vs proposer on 'pending').
_enforce_trade_config helper in routes/trades.py is reused by both single-trade and multi-party endpoints — good DRY.

Pre-existing (unrelated to this iter): wss://.../api/socket.io WebSocket handshake returns 403 in the preview env — surfaces as noisy console errors but does not affect any banner or trade functionality.
